children: Lupin shares gained in morning trade on Thursday after Nomura reaffirmed its 'Buy' rating and target price of Rs 2,675.
At 11:10 am, the Lupin stock was trading at Rs 2,070.20 on the NSE, up Rs 25.20, or 1.23%.

Nomura said management's goal is to build the specialty and innovation business over the long run, with "one-third of company revenues from the segment in the next 10 years". A large part of potential acquisition capital is also expected to be directed towards the segment.

The brokerage said management expressed strong confidence in "sustaining India growth at 1.2-1.3x market growth medium term", execution on complex generics, particularly respiratory, over the next 3-5 years, with key filings expected in FY27F, and "significant product-specific upside from Apixaban 505b(2) near term".
Management also expects to sustain double-digit growth in other markets outside India and the US over the medium term.

Nomura said Lupin expects to sustainably grow 20-30% ahead of the broader India market in the medium term. "Cardiac, anti-diabetic and respiratory contribute ~60% of sales and are expected to be key growth drivers over the next five years," the brokerage said, adding that the company is focused on market penetration and field-force productivity.

On the US business, Nomura said the trough is likely to be short-lived, with US revenues potentially exceeding FY26F levels in two years. Near-term US revenues are expected to decline sequentially due to additional competition in gJynarque (Tolvaptan), its largest product.

The brokerage said Apixaban 505b(2) and pegfilgrastim are two material near-term opportunities. Apixaban's current brand sales are around $10 billion, while Lupin expects to launch its 505b(2) product in Q1FY28E.

Nomura added that Lupin is leveraging its complex-generics and respiratory capabilities across geographies, reducing dependence on the US. It expects the base business EBITDA margin, without high-value product launches, to remain at 20-21% and aims to reach 24-25% over the years as the business mix improves.
Nomura's target price of Rs 2,675 is based on 30x FY28F adjusted EPS, excluding gJynarque, of Rs 89.1.

title: Lupin shares gain over 1 % after Nomura reaffirms 'Buy', Rs 2,675 target
